look: Cobalt Wyrmworm, a A-rank GKOM variant from the Cobalt Burrowers family: tunnel-wide wyrm-worm rearing up, maw ringed with crystal teeth. Family anatomy: armoured segmented worms and grubs with ringed crystal teeth and cobalt shell plates. Build: large, heavy and imposing. GKOM rank cue: most of the body sheathed in GKOM crystal, natural surface only at the seams; the crystals are deep cobalt-blue crystal. A grapefruit-sized GKOM core orb, near-black with a liquid shimmer, is embedded visibly in its chest or body centre. Element Earth: amber, moss green and slate accents, vivid sweeping stone shards, crystal dust and drifting petals
